# waroom_incident_description_template (Resource)

Manages the incident description template of the Waroom organization. The template provides the initial description of new incidents.

~> **Note:** An organization has exactly one incident description template, so declare this resource at most once. Creating this resource overwrites any template already set, and destroying it clears the template. To stop managing the template without clearing it, remove the resource from the state with a `removed` block and `lifecycle { destroy = false }` (Terraform 1.7+) or with `terraform state rm`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The organization has only one incident description template, so declare this resource at most once.

# Write the content inline with a heredoc.
resource "waroom_incident_description_template" "example" {
  blob = <<-EOT
    ## Impact

    ## Current status

    ## Next update
  EOT
}

# Or read it from a Markdown file placed next to this configuration:
#
# resource "waroom_incident_description_template" "example" {
#   blob = file("${path.module}/incident_description.md")
# }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `blob` (String) The content of the incident description template. Must contain a non-whitespace character; destroy the resource to clear the template.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource ID. Always `default`, since the organization has only one template.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# The organization has only one incident description template, so the import ID is always "default"
import {
  to = waroom_incident_description_template.example
  id = "default"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The organization has only one incident description template, so the import ID is always "default"
terraform import waroom_incident_description_template.example default
```
